facts.text: I am planning a trip to visit my paternal grandparents in August.
My grandparents live in Orlando, Florida.
My grandparents love outdoor activities, especially walks and picnics.
I am interested in a mix of relaxation and cultural activities.
We are planning to spend a week with my grandparents.
I recently went through old family photos.
I found cool photos from my maternal grandparents' 50th wedding anniversary celebration.
My maternal grandparents' 50th wedding anniversary celebration was on June 17th.
I am planning to ask my siblings to help me plan a surprise brunch for my mom's birthday in July.
I am from the same area where my maternal grandparents live.
I was thinking of booking a table at a new bistro downtown.
The new bistro downtown just opened a few months ago.
I have heard great things about the new bistro downtown's brunch menu and atmosphere.
